svg.title: Feed rate over one shift, raw and after a hard limit
svg.desc: Top: raw records, flattened by five spikes of up to 1,000,000 t/h. Bottom: the same shift after removing records above 1,500 t/h, moving between about 850 and 1,120 t/h and following the real hourly averages.
svg.text: The real feed rate is in this line
After the hard upper limit, 1,500 t/h
